cohort: 11,064 women with gestational diabetes mellitus in China
finding: Women with a slow initial gestational weight gain followed by drastic weight gain had higher risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including small for gestational age, low birth weight, preterm birth, cesarean section, and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus who had slow initial gestational weight gain followed by drastic gestational weight gain were more likely to have a Cesarean section birth.
